scope: Source defaults and isolated fixture configuration; no production environment, live tariff database, credentials or provider accounts inspected.

tariffs.units: ILS; percentage settings are fractions in existing source
tariffs.validation: Admin allows known keys, finite n >= 0; fraction keys < 1; values stored in SQLite settings and overlaid on defaults. No configured live tariff snapshot is claimed.

environment.name: NODE_ENV
environment.behavior: Production startup requires persistent absolute DB_PATH, SUPPORT_CONTACT and identity mode.

environment.name: DB_PATH
environment.behavior: SQLite authoritative; WAL, FULL, foreign_keys ON, busy timeout 250ms; use isolated fixtures only.

environment.name: WIND_IDENTITY_MODE
environment.baselineDefault: development registration unless operator-verified; required explicitly in production
environment.behavior: operator-verified or self-service; not consumer identity proof.

environment.name: WIND_CONTACT_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED
environment.behavior: Only self-service + literal true enables closed contact-verification gate; not a mock provider bypass.

environment.name: WIND_ENABLED_SERVICES
environment.behavior: Comma-delimited allowlist parcel,ride,freight. Ride and freight implemented but disabled by default; no operating permission inferred.

environment.name: SUPPORT_CONTACT
environment.behavior: Escaped into legal pages; required in production; actual value deliberately not inspected.

environment.name: WEB_ROOT
environment.baselineDefault: public in development; none in production
environment.behavior: Static/SPA bundle; API and legal routes stay authoritative.

environment.name: WIND_EMAIL_FROM
environment.behavior: All three email settings required before provider adapter advertises readiness; does not prove real delivery.

environment.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
environment.behavior: Server only; value omitted.

environment.name: CLOUDFLARE_EMAIL_TOKEN
environment.behavior: Server only; never fixture, log or bundle.

environment.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_BASE
environment.behavior: Override for isolated provider tests only in this baseline.

environment.name: WIND_PUSH_SUBJECT
environment.baselineDefault: existing application HTTPS origin in source
environment.behavior: Override mailto/site; no private key exposed.

environment.name: SOUQ_PARTNER_KEY
environment.behavior: At least 32 characters; X-Partner-Key on server-to-server calls only; absent/short -> 503.

environment.name: OSRM_URL
environment.behavior: Self-hosted road routing; missing -> route_unavailable or disclosed estimated quote; not lawful-access proof.

environment.name: WIND_TRUST_PROXY
environment.behavior: Only literal 1 trusts x-real-ip for public auth throttles.

environment.name: PORT
environment.behavior: Listener port.

environment.name: HOST
environment.behavior: Listener binding.

environment.name: EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL
environment.behavior: Release requires public HTTPS origin without credentials/query/fragment.

environment.name: EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPPORT_WHATSAPP
environment.behavior: Support link hidden if absent; never store actual contact here.

environment.name: EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPPORT_CONTACT
environment.behavior: mailto/HTTPS fallback; value omitted.

environment.name: GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY
environment.behavior: Optional maps manifest configuration; not a server secret.

environment.name: WIND_RELEASE
environment.behavior: Literal 1 enables public HTTPS release guard.

environment.name: WIND_LOCAL_TEST
environment.behavior: Literal 1 is local debug only; prohibited for release.

environment.name: WIND_TEST_ROLE
environment.behavior: Synthetic role apps only; requires isolated loopback API.

environment.name: WIND_TEST_IDENTIFIER
environment.behavior: Never store raw identifiers in baseline output.

environment.name: WIND_TEST_PASSWORD
environment.behavior: Never record; cannot enter EAS/release bundle.

environment.name: EAS_BUILD
environment.behavior: EAS release guard; no cloud builds performed.

environment.name: WIND_KEYSTORE
environment.behavior: Local upload signing input; not inspected.

environment.name: WIND_STORE_PASSWORD
environment.behavior: Signing secret omitted.

environment.name: WIND_KEY_ALIAS
environment.behavior: Alias omitted.

environment.name: WIND_KEY_PASSWORD
environment.behavior: Signing secret omitted.
